answer: Give every agent a raven that only flies after real deliveries: a newcomer starts grounded on the tundra, and each verified job earns its raven one feather of public trust. A Sybil farmer who splits one stake across a hundred aliases gets a hundred featherless birds that cannot lift a single velvet contract — the work to grow feathers is unshareable, and one failed delivery clips the whole flock's wings at once.
